notes.pipeline: build_articles.py re-collects rows from corpus/samples/{wikinews,aozora,yasashii} and the 8-text v11 catalog (it exits unless it finds exactly 8 v11 texts), and refuses to drop index rows without --allow-drop; feed_ingest.py/feed_fresh.py re-add the corpus/datasets/fresh rows. Removing rows in stage 2 needs a curated shelf filter (or --allow-drop plus source edits), not just deleting files.
notes.shintoTests: prototypes/corridor/tools/verify-native-readings.py asserts all 30 Shinto originals (docs/content/bunki-originals-zoka-sanjin.jsonl + editorial sidecar + first40 baseline) and scripts/verify-release-gates.mjs lists the same 30; both must be reduced to the 3 kept before the other 27 leave the shelf. verify-native-readings.mjs names silent-amenominakanushi and prayer-reality; verify-pr77-ports.mjs names miracle-testimony; verify-reader-gloss.mjs names feel-jingu-musubi and musubi-visual.
notes.yasashiiTests: verify-corridor.mjs (refProbe target yasashii:6), verify-playback.mjs (yasashii:6, yasashii:7 narration fixture), verify-vocabulary-chooser.mjs (yasashii:1, yasashii:2), verify-pr77-ports.mjs (openRow yasashii:1). If the glossary stays reachable as dictionary entries, these may only need the shelf assertion changed.
